settings.title: What is water soluble CBD?
settings.text: Water-soluble CBD is a form of cannabidiol (CBD) that has been processed to dissolve in water, unlike traditional CBD oil which is oil-soluble. This transformation is achieved through technologies like nanoemulsions, which break CBD into micro-sized particles. Water-soluble CBD is more easily absorbed by the body, enhancing its bioavailability and effectiveness. It's particularly useful in beverages and edibles, offering a convenient and effective way to consume CBD without the oily texture and distinct taste associated with oil-based products.

settings.title: Is water soluble CBD better than CBD Oil?
settings.text: Water-soluble CBD undergoes a process where it is formulated into a water miscible format such as an emulsion which disperses freely in water rather than floating on the surface. Up to 60% of the adult body is made of water, and H2O can be found in all organs and tissues. his means water-soluble CBD will be absorbed into the body more easily and quickly, resulting in more of it entering your bloodstream. With water-soluble CBD, the CBD bypasses the ‘first pass effect’. Oil-based CBD formulations appear to go through the liver where much of the CBD gets metabolized and excreted from the body.This means more time is required for the CBD to take effect and much less is absorbed. As water-soluble CBD is in a form that circumvents the liver, it is able to take effect and be absorbed much faster.

settings.title: Can I take water soluble CBD without water?
settings.text: Water-soluble CBD is designed to be easily dissolved in water and can be consumed without the need for additional water. It is typically available in the form of edibles, powders, and capsules. Dissolvable CBD powders allow for convenient and versatile use, as the water-soluble CBD can be added to beverages, such as juice or tea, directly. However, following product instructions and dosage recommendations is crucial to ensure proper usage and effectiveness.

settings.title: How long does it take for water-soluble CBD to kick in?
settings.text: The time it takes for water-soluble CBD to kick in can vary depending on several factors, including dosage and individual metabolism. The effects may take longer to manifest when CBD is taken orally, such as in the form of capsules or edibles, as it needs to be metabolized by the liver. Taking with food can hasten absorption. Additionlly, we recommend giving your CBD regimen 4-6 weeks to build up in your system before ultimately deciding whether or not to continue. settings.title: Why choose water soluble CBD?
settings.text: Water-soluble CBD is chosen for its enhanced bioavailability; it's more easily absorbed by the body compared to oil-based CBD. This means you can get the same benefits from a lower dose, making it a more efficient and cost-effective option. Water-soluble CBD is also versatile. As a dissolvable powder, it can be added to beverages or food without the oily texture or distinct taste of CBD oil. However, it also comes in capsule, gummy, and topical forms. It's ideal for those who want quick absorption and maximum efficacy from their CBD products.

settings.title: What is Smartsorb™ technology?
settings.text: SmartSorb™ Technology refers to an advanced formulation method used in NextEvo Naturals' CBD products to enhance the bioavailability of CBD. This technology typically involves converting CBD into a water-soluble form, allowing for quicker and more efficient absorption by the body. SmartSorb™ aims to improve the effectiveness of CBD by ensuring that a higher percentage of the active ingredient is absorbed into the bloodstream, thus maximizing its potential benefits. This technology is particularly useful in products where rapid onset and increased potency are desired.

settings.title: What is water soluble CBD used for?
settings.text: Water-soluble CBD is used for its enhanced bioavailability and faster onset of effects compared to oil-based CBD. It's commonly found in beverages, edibles, and topical products. Water-soluble CBD is particularly useful in products where quick absorption is desired, such as for stress relief, to reduce pain associated with inflammation, and to improve sleep. It's also beneficial in products like CBD-infused drinks and gummies, providing an easy and convenient way to consume CBD without the oily texture and taste of traditional CBD oil.

settings.title: How do I choose the best water soluble CBD?
settings.text: Selecting the best water-soluble CBD products involves considering several factors. Start by checking the product's source of CBD and ensure that it is derived from high-quality hemp plants and made in water-soluble format as CBD in oil format does not absorb well in the human body. Look for third-party lab test results to verify the potency and purity of the products and that they are THC free. Consider the dosage strength that aligns with your specific needs and preferences. Additionally, check for any additional ingredients in the products and ensure they meet your dietary requirements. Finally, read customer reviews and consider the brand's reputation for quality and transparency. These considerations will guide you in choosing the best water-soluble CBD products for you.

settings.title: Which water soluble CBD product is right for me?
settings.text: The right water-soluble CBD product for you depends on your specific needs and preferences. Consider why you're using CBD – for general wellness, stress relief, sleep improvement, or inflammation management? Also, do you prefer to take supplements in gummy form, capsule, or as a dissolvable powder? Water-soluble CBD products are known for their higher bioavailability, meaning your body can absorb and utilize them more efficiently compared to oil-based products.

How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.
